acceptance: Non-Databricks tuning configs carry no databricks_* keys after load and in bundles (unit test).
Snowflake templates carry no Delta-only header keys.
context: Found 2026-10-13 by two adversarial reviews at origin/develop 77048bfb9; visible in tpch_sf1_snowflake_sql_20261012_173334_97f9cfe1 requested.platform_optimizations.
description:
## Problem
`UnifiedTuningConfiguration.from_dict` (`benchbox/core/tuning/interface.py:1276-1284`, added in #2177) sets `databricks_clustering_strategy: z_order` for any platform whenever a table has clustering and the key is absent. `to_dict` always writes the key (`:825`), and `_non_default_platform_optimizations` keeps it. Snowflake tuned bundles therefore show the key in `requested.platform_optimizations`. Behaviour is unaffected, but the requested record and the config hash are polluted. The cloud template generator also writes Delta-only header keys into Snowflake templates (`scripts/generate_cloud_tpc_templates.py:151-158`).

## Change
- Remove the inference; the Databricks adapter already infers the strategy at `benchbox/platforms/databricks/adapter.py:409-415`.
- Omit `databricks_*` and Delta-only keys for other platforms.
- Note in the change that config hashes for Snowflake runs change.
